test_launch: test the python function launchers.test_launch to verify PartialState can be initialized
run_notebook_launcher_tpu: run the python function notebook_launcher to launch training on TPU cores in Colab or Kaggle
run_notebook_launcher_multi_gpu: run the python function notebook_launcher to launch distributed multi-GPU training from a Jupyter notebook
run_notebook_launcher_cpu: run the python function notebook_launcher to launch single-process CPU or GPU training from a notebook
run_debug_launcher: run the python function debug_launcher to launch a training function using multiple CPU processes for debugging
